textConnection: The adapter keeps exactly ONE TCP connection to the gateway and sends all requests strictly one after another. A timeout only fails its own block; the connection is only re-established after several failures in a row or when the gateway closes it.
errHost: Please enter an IP address or host name
helpRequestGap: In addition to the pause of the group
labelReconnectAfter: Reconnect after failures in a row
helpReconnectAfter: Timeouts / transport errors of any group; Modbus exceptions do not count
helpWriteMaxAge: e.g. while the connection is down
helpNoFC16: Always FC6, one register after the other (as in ioBroker.modbus)
labelMaxGap: Max. gap bridged in one request
helpMaxGap: Same algorithm as ioBroker.modbus, applied per group
helpAlwaysUpdate: Otherwise only changes are written (as in ioBroker.modbus)
textGroups: Each register belongs to one group. Every group has its own interval, request timeout and an optional pause after each of its requests (the SBH400 battery needs 5000 ms on the RS485 bus). Diagnostics per group: info.groups.<name>.*
textRegisters: Same columns as ioBroker.modbus. State ID = <address>_<name>, address with offset (30001 input / 40001 holding). 'Group' assigns the poll group.
helpReadOnly: e.g. for the first days after a migration: holding registers are read but never written
textStatus: Live values of the running instance (read-only). The section per group shows the last complete round (heartbeat), the response time and the counters of today. Values that do not change are not rewritten - an old timestamp at a register is therefore no fault, the heartbeat shows whether the bus is running. Only the groups live, energie, steuerung and akku are shown here.
stNotAlive: Instance %s is not running - the values below are not updated
titleMeasured: Limits measured on a reference installation (SH20T + SBH400 via WiNet-S2)
textMeasured: live 3 s (and 2 s) => skipped rounds, the bus does not finish a round in time; akku 60 s => battery timeouts and further skipped live rounds (5 s instruction interval of the SBH400 blocks the bus). Proven: live 5 s, energie 60 s, steuerung 60 s, akku 120 s with timeout 15000 ms and pause 5000 ms. Shorter values are possible for tests but are marked in red.
warnIntervalTooShort: Shorter than measured to be stable (live >= 5 s, akku >= 120 s) - saving is possible, but expect skipped rounds/timeouts
tipInterval: Seconds between two rounds of this group
warnTimeoutAkku: akku: the timeout must be longer than pause + 5000 ms instruction interval
tipTimeout: ms per request; at least 6000 (the WiNet has an instruction interval of 5000 ms for unit 2)
warnPauseAkku: akku: pause shorter than the 5000 ms instruction interval of the SBH400 - expect timeouts
tipPauseAfter: ms of silence on the bus after each request of this group (slow devices)
tipStates: Texts for known values: value:text;value:text, e.g. 170:on;85:off
textRegistersInput: Same columns as ioBroker.modbus. State ID = <address>_<name>, address with offset (30001 input / 40001 holding). 'Group' assigns the poll group. Note: 35016 is the current of MPPT 3; its ID stays 35016_MPPT_2_Current for compatibility.
